page.overview:
Who is Bordanos?

Bordanos were a working class on Gammu. They were trained and bred to work the compression machinery that harnessed sewer gases. They had been bred without a sense of smell and the musculature of their shoulders and their arms had been increased.

Lucilla noticed a group of Bordanos when she was traveling the streets of Ysai with Burzmali.

Escaped Miles Teg was later disguised as a Bordano overseer to hide his identity from hostile people in Gammu.
